scientific_integrity: Analytical proof uses exact closure and discriminant/Jordan identities, with reproducibility checks. No independent audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Spectral classification applies only to invariant one-spin generator; the ring must be period-three and an order-three exceptional point requires cell count divisible by four. No independent priority certification.
title: A sharp three-bath oscillation threshold and third-order exceptional modes in Glauber rings
